name: comp-50

frames.best_why: All three fields are filled and the card number carries the Visa badge, showing the complete state.

tagline: Stacked card, expiry and CVC fields that reveal the card brand as you type.
summary: A compact card entry group: one wide card-number row with a brand logo slot, split below into expiry and CVC boxes. Digits are grouped automatically and the generic card glyph becomes a Visa badge.
appearance: Under a small "Card Details" heading, three dark fields join into one block with shared hairlines and rounded outer corners: a full-width number row with a small card glyph at its right, then an MM/YY box and a CVC box side by side.
behaviour: Typing numbers spaces the card number into groups of four, and once the first digits name the brand a coloured Visa badge replaces the plain card glyph. Focus raises a ring around whichever field is active; the expiry and CVC boxes accept their own values.
demo_content: Heading "Card Details", placeholders Card number, MM/YY and CVC, a 4242 test number and the React Payment Inputs credit.
search_phrases: credit card number expiry cvc form
type card and see visa logo
card number field with brand badge
use_when: A checkout or billing step needs the three standard card fields with automatic brand detection and a tidy grouped look.
avoid_when: It needs the react-payment-inputs dependency and only renders fields, with no validation text or pay action.
customise: There are no props: heading, field order and vendor credit are fixed, so changing layout, labels or copy means editing the file.
weight_why: Three inputs and a small brand badge; no loops, timers or heavy drawing.

a11y.note: The inputs and focus rings work, but fields depend on placeholders and library aria labels, and the heading is not tied to them.

polish_why: Tidy joined group and a live brand badge; otherwise plain stock inputs plus a vendor credit.
title: Card Details Form
